subject: Proposed Addendum: GPU Allocation Increase & SOW rework
messages:
From: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@greenoptics.com>
To: alex_martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>, monica_patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 09:12:03 -0700
Subject: Capacity add + small SOW edits — GreenOptics Q3 ramp

Hi Alex / Monica,

Quick note from our side — we expect a sustained 2.5x increase in inference volume beginning July 1 for our image-scoring pipelines. We need to add dedicated GPU capacity (NVIDIA H100-equivalent) and also tweak a few SOW items to reflect parallel inference testing and an extra integration sprint.

Attached is a draft addendum (GO-Addendum-v1.pdf) that our procurement team put together with the changes we think are needed. High level asks:
- Add 8 reserved GPUs for July–Sept (monthly billing + ramp credits)
- Update SOW section 2.2 to include parallel A/B rollout and performance validation window (2 weeks)
- Clarify support SLA for burst days (we expect spikes during model re-training windows)

Can you confirm whether Redwood can cover the requested capacity and provide a redline/ETA? We’re trying to close procurement by the end of next week.

Thanks — Tom
Tom Reynolds
Head of Infrastructure
GreenOptics Inc.

Attachment: GO-Addendum-v1.pdf (redlines)

From: alex_martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
To: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@greenoptics.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@greenoptics.com>
Cc: monica_patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 10:03:18 -0700
Subject: Re: Capacity add + small SOW edits — GreenOptics Q3 ramp

Tom — thanks for the note and the draft addendum. We can support the requested profile but want to run through pricing tiers and a short SOW clarification before we lock numbers. Next steps I propose: 

1) Redwood legal & pricing will produce a redline to the addendum (target EOD Thu).
2) We’ll create a short mutual action plan (MAP) that ties milestones to billing start and the 2-week validation window.
3) Confirm implementation dates and an on-call window for burst days (we’ll draft recommended coverage).

Karthik — looping you for contract redlines and any standard language we should include around burst credits. Monica — can you scope the implementation workback and populate the attached workbook (implementation-workback.xlsx)?

Tom — I’ll send the redline and MAP by Thursday. If you need a faster cadence, we can set a 30-min sync.

Cheers,
Alex Martinez
Account Executive, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
alex.martinez@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0142

From: alex_martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, monica_patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 26 May 2027 08:45:02 -0700
Subject: Internal: GreenOptics addendum — redline + pricing guidance

Team — forwarding Tom’s addendum and my reply. Quick asks for legal/pricing review: 

- Karthik: please review GO-Addendum-v1.pdf and propose language for
  * burst-day credits (we usually cap at X days / month, propose 10 burst days with per-hour surcharge)
  * SLA clause for transient latency degradation during validation windows
  * a clause to pin model-version upgrades that could affect performance (GreenOptics wants faster model churn)

- Laura: any procurement constraints re: billing dates or tax/regulatory language we should flag? GreenOptics is US-based (CA) but they may want specific invoicing terms.
- Monica: fill timeline in implementation-workback.xlsx — include the 2-week validation window and a single-week buffer for rollbacks.

I attached the company-annotated MSA that GreenOptics sent separately (GreenOptics_MSA-annotated.docx). I’ll assemble a tracked redline and a clean addendum for sign-off. Target to have everything ready for DocuSign by Friday 28 May close of business.

Thanks — Alex

From: alex_martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
To: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@greenoptics.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@greenoptics.com>
Cc: monica_patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 28 May 2027 17:03:01 -0700
Subject: Final proposed addendum + DocuSign link — GreenOptics (GOPT-2027-1184)

Tom / Priya — thanks for the quick turnaround this week. Attached is the redlined addendum and a clean execution copy: GO-Addendum-v1.pdf (redlines) and GO-Addendum-CLEAN.pdf. Highlights of changes we included after internal review: 

- Capacity: 8 reserved H100-equivalent GPUs July 1 — Sept 30, with a prorated billing start tied to successful completion of the 2-week validation window.
- Burst days: capped at 12 burst days/month; beyond that, usage billed at a defined surcharge rate. We included a mitigation clause for system-wide incidents.
- SOW edits: explicit parallel A/B rollout plan, two-week validation window, one-week rollback buffer, and responsibilities matrix for engineering handoffs.
- MSA clarifications: pinning of major model-version upgrades that materially affect latency without 30-day notice.

Next steps:
1) Please review the clean addendum and redline by EOD Mon (31 May).
2) If acceptable, sign via DocuSign here: https://www.docusign.com/prepare/GOPT-1184-addendum
3) Monica will kick off the implementation plan on acceptance; I’ve attached the implementation-workback.xlsx with dates tied to July 1 start.

If you want a 30-min walk-through of the SOW changes, Monica and I are available Mon afternoon.

Thanks again — looking forward to getting this live for Q3.

Best,
Alex Martinez
Account Executive, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
alex.martinez@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0142

Attachments: GO-Addendum-v1.pdf (redlines); GO-Addendum-CLEAN.pdf; implementation-workback.xlsx
